Portrait inlay / rank and figure emblems

text.tspan: A revenue assistant checks receipts and records the passage
of money and grain. Patient accuracy makes the treasury's
figures traceable, giving its larger decisions a firmer
basis than rumour, pressure, or convenient memory.
